Midslope south of prairie invaded by oaks, upslope of area cleared within the last few years. Topographic Context, upper/middle/lower.

Smooth and undulating plateau with 30% rock outcrop. Vegetation in crevices and shallow depressions. Excessively well-drained. Stunted red oak 60 and 28 years; jack pines 38 years. Much dead jack pine, probably killed by fire /date and month unknown.
On benched hillside; topography flat, no rock outcrops. Soil: average 46 cm depth, well-drained loam.  Green ash 70 years, aspen 60 years. Date and month unknown.
Soil: deep, poorly-drained sedge peat. Black ash 195 years. Date and month unknown.
On hilltop; topography rough and broken by rock outcrops (10% cover). Soil: 2-13 cm over bedrock; excessively drained. Jack pine 53 years. Date and month unknown.

Typical upland black spruce stand on hilltop, broken by many moss-covered rock outcrops. Soil: shallow, 9-20 cm over bedrock to 32-46 cm in crevices. Black spruce 60 years. Much dead balsam fir. Date and month unknown.

npc_type_name: Red Pine - White Pine Woodland (Canadian Shield)
remarks: On midslope; rock outcrops common in area, not in plot. Soil: well-developed 1-20 cm over bedrock, some deeper areas; red pine 93 years, white cedar 85 years. Location to 1/4 section. Date and month unknown.

Stand on midslope with few rock outcrops. Well-drained sandy loam 5-46+ cm (average 10 cm) depth. White spruce 90 years, aspen 45 years. Moderately high mortality of white spruce and balsam fir. Location to 1/4 sec. Date and month unknown.
On lower portion of benched hillside. Topography smooth, unbroken by only a few outcrops. Soil: well-drained loamy sand, 22 cm. Big-tooth aspen 70 years. Date and month unknown.
Soil: Deep poorly-drained Sphagnum peat. Date and month unknown.
Uneven-aged black spruce up to 200 years. Soil: poorly-drained sphagnum peat. Date and month unknown.
Typical stand in flat lowland area on island, adjacent to Lake Kabetogama. Soil: deep, well-drained sandy loam. Black ash 165 years. Date and month unknown.
Level plain behind bay. Typed as marsh. Standing water. Date and month unknown.
On hill top; rough and broken topography. Soil excessively drained. 0-45 cm depth to bedrock; outcrops 10%. Stunted trees 25 years old. Location to 1/3 section. Date and Month unknown.

npc_type_name: Red Pine - White Pine Woodland (Canadian Shield)
remarks: Approx 100 year-old red pine on midslope. Soil shallow loamy sand (2-18 cm) over bedrock. 10% rock outcrop. Date and month unknown.
Soil: deep peat. Dead trees present indicate apparent fluctuation in water table. Date and month unknown.

Topography smooth, no rock outcrops. Soil: shallow(8cm) over bedrock, sandy with rocks; well-drained. Bur oak 155 years, basswood 95 years, aspen 55-75 years. 75 year-old balsam fir defoliated (dead). Date and month unknown.

Stand on middle and lower part of hillside. Well-drained sandy loam, shallow (6-14 cm) over bedrock to deep (46 cm). Balsam fir 80 yrs. Stand previously jack pine. High mortality balsam fir and jack pine. Date and month unknown.

Stand on plateau. Soil: shallow over bedrock, well-drained sandy loam with rock fragments. Bur oak 90 years, white pine 85 years, aspen 50 years. High mortality aspen and paper birch. Date and month unknown.
Lowland area behind bay. Peat soil. White cedar 95-150 years old. Date and month unknown.

Well-developed and highly unusual understory of aspen(high light penetra-ion due to adjacent rock outcrops). Topography smooth, no outcrops in plot. Soil: >60 cm sandy, well-drained. Aspen 63-65 years. Date and month unknown.
Mid-slope, peninsula, rolling. Moderately well-drained loam, few stones, 16-30cm. Paper birch 69 years, aspen 74 years. Rock outcrop 10%. Date and month unknown.
Between 2 islands. Very poorly-drained sedge peat. Date and month unknown
Upper slope of a peninsula. Broken topography. Rock outcrop 5%. Well-drained loamy sand, shallow, 2-11 cm to bedrock. Jack pine 59-64 years. Date and month unknown
Valley, flat, filled in depression. Very poorly-drained sphagnum peat. Black spruce 140 years. Date and month unknown.
Poorly-drained sphagnum peat. Jack pine 40-67 years. Black spruce 57-78 years. Date and month unknown.
Lower slope, stream valley. Soil very stony, well-drained loamy sand, shallow, 2-15 cm to bedrock.  Aspen 76 years, balsam fir 55-66 years. Date and month unknown.
Ridge top, benched. Well-drained loamy sand, very stony, 1-30 cm to bedrock. Jack pine 52-68 years. Much dead.  Rock <5%. Date and month unknown.

Peninsula, mid-slope, benched. Moderately drained, very stony, sandy loam. Shallow soil. Black spruce 37 years, balsam fir 44 years. Red pine stumps, and even age indicates past logging. Date and month unknown.
Ridge top plateau, flat. 2-23 cm moderately well-drained stony sandy loam. Black spruce 47 years, balsam fir 34 years. Date and month unknown.

npc_type_name: Red Pine - White Pine Woodland (Northeastern Bedrock)
remarks: Island, broken, ridge top. Well-drained sandy loam, 1-30 cm to bedrock. White pine 22-75 years, red pine 73-125 years. Date and month unknown.
Rock <1%. Date and month unknown.

npc_type_name: Black Ash - Aspen - Balsam Poplar Swamp (Northeastern)
remarks: Flat lowland on island. Very poorly-drained fairly deep sandy loam. Black ash 108 years, elm 105 years. Date and month unknown.
Undulating ridge top; 20% rock outcrop; well-drained sandy loam 1-15 cm over bedrock; aspen and white spruce 35 years. Date and Month unknown.
Hilly, upper slope, near lakeshore. Moderately well-drained, 9-32 cm. Paper birch 59 years, several dead. Date and Month unknown.
Flat. Very poorly-drained sphagnum peat. Black spruce 34 years. Date and month unknown.
Upper slope, rolling. Well-drained, moderately stony, sandy loam, 8-30 cm to bedrock. Aspen 29-35 years. Rock 5%. Date and month unknown.
Lower slope, stream valley, rolling. Moderately well-drained silt loam. Paper birch 39 years. Several dead white pine. Date and month unknown.
Benched. 60% rock outcrop. Excessively well-drained, loamy sand. Shallow, 1-30 cm to bedrock.  Jack pine 32 years. Date and month unknown.
Midslope, undulating. Well-drained, loamy sand, >30 cm deep to bedrock. Aspen and balsam fir 55 years. Date and month unknown.

npc_type_name: Red Pine - White Pine Woodland (Canadian Shield)
remarks: Park-like stand. Upper slope, benched. Well-drained, very stony, loamy sand. Moderately shallow, 1-20 cm to bedrock. Red pine 95 years, white pine 76, 87 years. Date and month unknown.
Lakeshore area. Poorly-drained sedge peat. Lake with variable level. Date and month unknown.
Lower slope, lowland. Poorly-drained, silt loam, >30 cm to bedrock. Aspen 93 years, black ash 115 years. Date and month unknown.
Ridgetop, undulating. Moderately well-drained, sandy loam, 8-20 cm to bedrock. White pine 86 years, red pine 142 years. Date and month unknown.
Very poorly-drained sphagnum peat. Date and month unknown.
Stream valley. Poorly-drained silt loam. Paper birch 65 years. No rock outcrop. Date and month unknown.
On island ridgetop, undulating. Well-drained sandy loam, 6-21 cm to bedrock.  White pine 70, 110 years, red oak 61-77 years. Rock 10%. Date and month unknown.
This area obviously managed with fire. Area is also unfortunately used as an informal dump. Date and month unknown.
2 miles south of 71-01, more shrubby and overgrown than 71-01. Date and month unknown.

Plot is located in a small basin (60m x 40m) southwest of Wolsfield Lake. Dominated by Carex rostrata, two Sphagnum hummocks are present in the center of the marsh, each supporting a single tamarack tree. Basin surrounded by maple-basswood forest. Date and Month unknown.
Date and Month unknown. One fourth inch litter layer of leaves and twigs. Soil: Light black loamy clay over reddish brown clay. Many fibrous roots in A horizon. Medium dry soil.

Many windfalls; fairly open. Soil: 13 cm loam over 18cm loamy sand with >10% coarse fragments over sandy loam with fragipan. Microtopography uniform. Soil series 510. 1% moss cover, 15% slash, 2% rocks, 77% litter, and 5% grass. Date and Month unknown.

A medium moist level site in gently rolling area. Very large and healthy red pines. No indication of past disturbances. Heavy needle (twigs) layer on forest floor, 1 inch thick. Reproduction is composed of maple, oak, and white pine. Two aspen stumps and one small red pine log on the plot. Succession is moving toward white pine stand. Hazel is thick. Soil:2 inches brown loam over 2 inches sandy loam over light brown loamy sand over reddish brown gravelly sand.Medium dry soil, many roots throughout A and upper B horizons. Date and month unknown.

Lowland site. Date and Month unknown. The site is dry now but moist part of the year. Young and medium healthy aspen stand. A few alder trees with very poor form present. Many small dead standing aspen. No sign of past disturbance. Reproduction almost nonexistent, composed of aspen and red maple. Hazel and bracken fern very light. Thin litter layer of leaves and grass. Soil: 3 inches black loam over greyish brown fine sandy loam over olive brown fine sandy loam. Medium number of roots in A horizon, no rocks present. Medium dry soil.

Very little hazel, no bracken. Slight erosion from standing water. Surrounding area rolling, plot on midslope on Creek Valley. Damp site. Aspen (56 years) scraggly with clones not vigorous. Site appears damp. Date and Month unknown. Ground cover: 2% moss, 2% mineral, 3% slash, 93% litter.
